episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: During the early years of the Revolutionary War, a Long Island farmer is recruited to spy on the British army.

episodes.title: Who by Fire
episodes.summary: To prevent Anna being blamed for the murder of a Royal Officer, Abe must find the culprit; Ben and Caleb interrogate Simcoe.

episodes.title: Of Cabbages and Kings
episodes.summary: On the run from the British, Ben is betrayed by his own militia. Abe travels with Richard to New York to spy. Mary confronts Anna.

episodes.title: Eternity How Long
episodes.summary: Abe and Richard grapple with orders to dig up gravestones; Ben and Caleb try to get their intelligence to General Washington.

episodes.title: Epiphany
episodes.summary: Celeb and Ben follow mysterious orders; Washington's army crosses into enemy territory

episodes.title: Mr. Culpeper
episodes.summary: Abe heads to New York and runs into a desperate patriot along the way. Ben is tasked with creating America's first spy ring.

episodes.title: Mercy Moment Murder Measure
episodes.summary: An old threatening presence returns to Setauket, worrying Abe that Anna is no longer protected.

episodes.title: Challenge
episodes.summary: Anna looks for enemy intelligence at an exclusive gentleman's party against Abe's wishes.

episodes.title: Against Thy Neighbor
episodes.summary: Simcoe tries to hunt out the rebel conspirators in Setauket through a political witch-hunt. Ben is sent away on a secret mission.

episodes.title: The Battle of Setauket
episodes.summary: Mary struggles when she realizes that Abe is a spy working for the other side. Ben and Caleb hope to save Patriot families when they carry out a raid on Setauket.

episodes.title: Thoughts of a Free Man
episodes.summary: A spy in London sends an urgent message to America. Mary impedes Abe's attempt to restart the spy ring. Benedict Arnold arrives in camp.

episodes.title: Hard Boiled
episodes.summary: Abe gathers intelligence in New York. Simcoe escapes his punishment. John Andre attends a ball in Philadelphia and meets Peggy Shippen.

episodes.title: False Flag
episodes.summary: Ben sets a trap to capture a traitor in camp. Richard discovers Abe is conspiring with Major Hewlett. Caleb collides with Robert Rogers.

episodes.title: Men of Blood
episodes.summary: Abe tries to recruit a new agent in New York; Caleb races Rogers as they hunt down intelligence from London; Andre's history is exposed.

episodes.title: Sealed Fate
episodes.summary: Abe makes a last-ditch effort to recruit a spy inside New York. Meanwhile, Ben must determine which of two deserters is a double agent.

episodes.title: Houses Divided
episodes.summary: Mary pleads with Richard to help free Abe from prison; Anna must seduce Simcoe; Ben and Caleb plot to rescue Hewlett from his captors.

episodes.title: Valley Forge
episodes.summary: Washington faces a personal crisis with the help of his slave Billy Lee. Meanwhile, Abe struggles to maintain his cover while in prison.

episodes.title: Providence
episodes.summary: Caleb sails a one-man submersible into New York Harbor; France becomes an ally to America; Andre and Peggy plot to elope.

episodes.title: The Prodigal
episodes.summary: Abe returns from prison with crucial information; tensions rise between Hewlett and Simcoe; Arnold rescues Peggy.

episodes.title: Gunpowder, Treason, and Plot
episodes.summary: In the Season 2 finale, Abe plots to assassinate Major Hewlett; Ben fights at the Battle of Monmouth; and Benedict Arnold continues to covet Peggy Shippen.

episodes.title: Valediction
episodes.summary: Abe covers up a murder with an unlikely accomplice. Elsewhere, Benedict Arnold abuses his power as he settles into a new home in Philadelphia.

episodes.title: Cold Murdering Bastards
episodes.summary: Anna tries to save the ring after Abe's cover is blown, and Benedict Arnold seeks Washington's help against charges of treason. Meanwhile, Townsend sends a signal.

episodes.title: Benediction
episodes.summary: Peggy manipulates Benedict Arnold into contacting the British; and Caleb sets an ambush for Simcoe. Meanwhile, Anna tries to save Major Hewlett's life.

episodes.title: Hearts and Minds
episodes.summary: A mysterious woman rescues Ben; Abe tries to stop Anna and Hewlett's marriage; Arnold negotiates with the British and Andre' betrays Peggy

episodes.title: Hypocrisy, Fraud and Tyranny
episodes.summary: Townsend uncovers a British counterfeiting operation. Rogers threatens to destroy Abe's spying ring. Simcoe threatens Richard.

episodes.title: Many Mickles Make a Muckle
episodes.summary: Washington attends Benedict Arnold's ball in Philadelphia. Abe races to stop Rogers before he reaches Townsend. Old friends and enemies intersect.

episodes.title: Judgement
episodes.summary: Mary tries to kill Simcoe on her own; and Benedict Arnold defends himself in his own court-martial. Meanwhile, Ben reunites with the woman who saved his life.

episodes.title: Mended
episodes.summary: The Culper Ring is resurrected in time to save Washington's army. Simcoe terrorizes Setauket as he hunts for Rogers. Anna infiltrates New York.

episodes.title: Blade on the Feather
episodes.summary: Benedict Arnold plots to turn over West Point to the British. Andre negotiates for Peggy. Abe plots revolt in Setauket.

episodes.title: Trial and Execution
episodes.summary: There is an inevitable march to the gallows for the captured spies on both sides.

episodes.title: Spyhunter General
episodes.summary: Benedict Arnold rounds up spies in New York; and Abe plots to destroy essential British supplies, but he will need his father's help.

episodes.title: The Black Hole of Calcutta
episodes.summary: When one of the Culper Ring members is captured, Arnold seeks to interrogate him with the help of a ruthless Col. Simcoe.

episodes.title: Blood for Blood
episodes.summary: Abe's scheme to rescue Caleb turns deadly; Anna faces a difficult decision; and Arnold suspects Peggy is keeping a secret from him.

episodes.title: Nightmare
episodes.summary: A mutiny erupts in camp. The Culpepper ring must find a new course. Benedict finds an unlikely ally. Townsend learns a lesson from Rivington.

episodes.title: Private Woodhull
episodes.summary: As he ultimately seeks to gain his revenge against Lt. John Simcoe, Abe journeys to New York and is introduced to Benedict Arnold; Anna's history comes into play, as a visitor from her past arrives in the continental camp.

episodes.title: Our Man in New York
episodes.summary: The plot to kidnap Benedict Arnold is hatched. Peggy learns Cicero's secret. Washington and the French clash over strategy.

episodes.title: Quarry
episodes.summary: Ben's plan to kidnap Benedict Arnold conflicts with Abe's plot to kill Simcoe. Shifting loyalties turn old enemies into allies.

episodes.title: Belly of the Beast
episodes.summary: As Abe is thrust into battle, Ben appeals to General Washington. Townsend risks everything, while Caleb seeks redemption.

episodes.title: Reckoning
episodes.summary: After receiving Abe's intel, Washington heads south to lay siege on Yorktown. Abe volunteers for the Continental Army. Peggy goes into labor.

episodes.title: Washington's Spies
episodes.summary: The fate of the Culper Ring is revealed; the American War of Independence comes to an end; a settling of accounts between shadows and spies; America struggles to begin.
